evidence_items.locator: June 10, 2026 note, The finding; associated plan table and utilization display
evidence_items.explanation: The reproduced inputs yield -25% for the two lower Anthropic tiers and lower margins for every other listed tier. This supports the arithmetic under the specified assumption, not actual profitability.

metric_scope.metric: Modeled subscription gross margin at 25% utilization assuming 75% API gross margin

inputs: Claude Pro: monthly price $20; maximum API-equivalent usage $400.
Claude Max 5x: monthly price $100; maximum API-equivalent usage $2,000.
Claude Max 20x: monthly price $200; maximum API-equivalent usage $8,000.
ChatGPT Plus: monthly price $20; maximum API-equivalent usage $700.
ChatGPT Pro 5x: monthly price $100; maximum API-equivalent usage $3,500.
ChatGPT Pro 20x: monthly price $200; maximum API-equivalent usage $14,000.
Utilization u = 0.25; assumed API gross margin g = 0.75.
derived.formula: For monthly price P and maximum API-equivalent usage V: margin = 100 × [P − u × V × (1 − g)] / P. Results in listed order: −25%, −25%, −150%, −118.75%, −118.75%, −337.5%.
derived.rounding: Exact arithmetic on the source's rounded usage estimates; results shown to at most two decimal places.

unresolved_gaps: The numerical inputs were checked through a secondary reproduction, not original test logs.
Actual serving costs and subscriber workload mixtures are not established by this model.
